phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F7 Phase A — Financial Derivatives Source-Coverage and Scale Screening
scientific_interpretation: The official ECB QSA F7 dimensions are valid for Romania and return non-zero total-economy stock and transaction controls.
None of the 35 in-boundary bilateral F7 cells is published or exactly recoverable from the tested W2/W1 orientations for either stock or 2025 flow.

Observed zero resident aggregates are retained only as aggregate equations. They are not converted into bilateral zeros because no non-negativity or issuer-applicability premise is introduced in Phase A.

The non-zero aggregate controls demonstrate that F7 cannot be discarded as an all-zero instrument. Phase A does not assign a materiality verdict because no materiality threshold or denominator was preregistered.
The remaining evidence supports an exact aggregate-control rank/nullspace gate; it does not support synthetic counterpart allocation.

next_gate.name: F7 Phase B — exact aggregate-control rank/nullspace audit
required_checks: use every available resident W0 holder/issuer F7 aggregate equation
use published W0 total-economy and W1 external F7 equations without double-counting their linear dependence
compute exact rational coefficient rank and nullspace over 35 in-boundary bilateral variables
report aggregate RHS accounting consistency within the existing 0.1 million RON tolerance
introduce no bilateral zero from an aggregate zero
introduce no materiality, issuer-applicability or non-negativity premise
freeze F7 if no unconditional bilateral coordinate is rank-unique
